race.comment: KIWI GEORGE (8) comes off a big run when third in a sharp 23.92 at Bendigo over 425m. Hard to top on the time from last start. MONTANA ICON (1) doesn't have the best strike-rate but recent form is sound. Filled a minor placings again last time when third (28.76) at Bendigo making it three placings in a row. Form here at the trip sound including five wins. Can feature again. MAX EFFORT (3) is an honest type in the frame at 31 of 72 starts including last time when second (25.50) over 450m at this track. Goes well from this draw. Best form too dangerous to ignore. Have to include. ZAMBADA ICON (2) can feature with the right run.
